en: A black-and-white illustrated postcard showing an industrial factory complex with several tall smoking chimneys. In the background, there is a prominent and recognizable castle or large historical building on a hill, as well as surrounding city structures and fields. There is some text at the bottom of the illustration, including credits to 'Brick & Sohn, Meissen.' and the label 'Kollreppwerk, Act.-Ges., Meissen.' On the top right corner, the number '2449' is written in red.
